title: Tailwind Weekly #229：cn、Anchor 定位以及前端开发的未来 ✨
author: Vivian Guillen
content:
Hello folks!

shadcn shipped cn, a drop-in for clsx and tailwind-merge that's 30× faster. You've also got Josh Comeau on CSS Anchor Positioning and monowind for Tailwind TUIs in the browser.

Let's dive in 👇

🌟 News

cn 0.2

shadcn and Aiden Bai shipped cn 0.2. It replaces clsx and tailwind-merge with the same APIs and zero deps. Migrate with npx shadcn@latest migrate cn, then import { cn } from "cn". A typical component call (cn(base, variant, condition && extra)) runs 30× faster but its Tailwind v4 only so stay on tailwind-merge v2 if you're still on v3.

New components in the shadcn ecosystem

Seven registries shipped new items this week:

  • react-bits – AeroShards, a GPU wind-sculpture of flowing foil shards for interactive backgrounds
  • magicui – floating-3d-particles, a canvas particle field with rotation and buoyant drift
  • reui – code-block (Shiki streaming, diffs, folding), data-grid cell-selection and i18n, plus gantt examples
  • intentui – radar-chart and radial-bar-chart
  • blocks.so – chat-01 and chat-02 AI chat threads (bubbles, streaming; chat-02 adds a model menu)
  • beui – adaptive-stepper, a numeric stepper that shrinks or hides the ± controls at min/max
  • spectrumui – seven pricing-section variants (banner, blueprint, dark-matrix, gradient, offset, receipt, and serif tiers)

🤩 Windy Picks

Picmal — convert and compress on your Mac

If you convert HEICs or compress a video to fit an email, Picmal does it on your Mac. Images, video, audio, and PDFs, over 100 formats, no uploads and no account.

Drop a folder in and it batch converts. You can compress without changing format, strip GPS from screenshots, split a PDF into pages, or hook the same engine into Finder, Raycast, and the CLI.

$39 once for 2 Macs. Pro is $69 for 5. 14-day refund. Mac only, Sequoia and up.

📚 Learning

Getting Started with Anchor Positioning

Tooltips and dropdowns used to mean a pile of JavaScript to keep them on screen. Josh Comeau walks through the CSS Anchor Positioning API that landed across major browsers in January 2026. Name the trigger with anchor-name: --my-anchor, point the floater at it with position-anchor and position-area: top, and the browser keeps it stuck. Overflow flips with position-try-fallbacks: flip-block, and Level 2 anchored container queries can swap the caret when it flips (Chromium for now). Support sits around 81% on caniuse, so he covers Oddbird's polyfill and @supports (position-area: top) fallbacks.

I used to hate Tailwind CSS

Yannick Kouakou spent more than five years avoiding Tailwind on principle after a Bootstrap-skeptical CSS upbringing. An apprenticeship in France put it in front of him every day, and the usual objections (separation of concerns, class soup, specificity wars) fell apart once he read Adam Wathan's utility-class essay and watched the shipped CSS stay tiny while components absorbed the verbosity. He builds Intrivio and Rigma on it now, and still tells his younger self to learn raw CSS first, then stop looking down on the tools. Useful if you still get the "isn't this just inline styles" pushback.

The asteroid currently hitting frontend web development

Nolan Lawson asked Claude a Chrome Style-recalc brain-teaser and got an answer on selector stats, invalidation scope, and custom properties. From there he maps why frontend education feels under pressure: agents treat UI as lower risk than migrations, "agent experience" is pushing teams toward React over Solid or Lit, and DX-focused standards look less urgent when a model can write three lines as easily as one. His bets for educators are teaching agents the big picture (MPA over SPA when it fits), building sites that agents can read, and consulting on vibe-coded messes while judgment still pays.

💅 Showcase

Ente Photos

Ente Photos is an open-source, end-to-end encrypted photo backup that runs on Android, iOS, web, Mac, Linux, and Windows. You get on-device face grouping, zero-knowledge natural-language search, shared albums, public links, and family plans that share storage with up to five people at no extra cost. 10GB free forever, paid plans from $2.49/mo for 50GB, self-hostable, cryptographically audited.

🎁 Resource

monowind

If you've wanted a terminal UI without leaving the browser, monowind wraps ordinary HTML and Tailwind utilities in <mono-wind> and renders a strict character grid: box-drawing borders, integer cells, monospace layout, with real links, buttons, focus, and forms still working. Flex, grid, multi-column, and table layouts are in; themes like dos, c64, and green-phosphor live in @monowind/themes; <mono-ascii> does FIGlet banners. Early development, with a live playground and Storybook.

👌 Cool Stuff

Windybase – Explore weekly curated free & premium Tailwind templates, components, and tools to help you build modern websites and apps fast.

Frame0 – Offline hand-drawn wireframes in a Balsamiq vein, with AI agent, MCP, frame mirroring, and HTML/PDF export.

Irid – Free early-access Mac toolbar for color picking, measuring, grids, and design overlays (macOS 12+, Intel for now).

Supaste – Visual Mac clipboard history with OCR, notch shelf, and inline shortcuts; one-time purchase, offline-first.

summary: 第 #229 期以 shadcn 发布 cn 0.2 开篇，这是一个零依赖的 clsx 和 tailwind-merge 替代品，在典型的组件 class 调用中运行速度提升 30 倍，但仅支持 Tailwind v4。通讯列出了 shadcn 生态系统中七项新的组件发布，包括交互式背景、数据表格、图表和 AI 聊天线程。还介绍了 Picmal，一款 Mac 原生媒体转换器。学习板块收录了 Josh Comeau 撰写的 CSS Anchor Positioning（现已广泛支持）指南、Yannick Kouakou 的从 Bootstrap 怀疑者转向 Tailwind 的转型随笔，以及 Nolan Lawson 的观察——AI 编程智能体将 UI 视为低风险工作，正对前端教育施加压力。展示板块介绍了 Ente Photos，一款加密开源照片备份服务。资源板块引入了 monowind，一款基于浏览器的终端 UI 库，将 HTML 和 Tailwind 包裹在字符网格中。

mainPoints.point: shadcn 发布了 cn 0.2，一个速度更快的零依赖替代品，用于替代 clsx 和 tailwind-merge。
mainPoints.explanation: cn 提供了与 clsx 和 tailwind-merge 结合相同的 API，但没有任何外部依赖，针对典型组件 class 调用的执行速度提升 30 倍。它仅支持 Tailwind v4，因此 v3 用户必须继续使用 tailwind-merge v2。

mainPoints.point: CSS Anchor 定位已获得广泛浏览器支持，简化了 tooltip 和下拉菜单的定位。
mainPoints.explanation: Josh Comeau 的指南解释了 2026 年 1 月进入主流浏览器的 API：用 anchor-name 命名触发元素，用 position-anchor 和 position-area 定位浮动元素，并用 position-try-fallbacks 处理溢出翻转。caniuse 支持率约 81%，且有 polyfill 可用。

mainPoints.point: AI 编程智能体正在对前端教育和工具选择施压。
mainPoints.explanation: Nolan Lawson 认为，智能体将 UI 工作视为比迁移更低风险的任务，'智能体体验'正在推动团队选择 React 而非 Solid 或 Lit 等替代方案。他建议教育工作者应该讲授宏观图景、构建智能体可读的网站，并在人类判断力仍有价值时参与 vibe-coded 项目的咨询。

mainPoints.point: 本周七项注册表发布了新组件，涵盖图表、数据表格和 AI 聊天线程。
mainPoints.explanation: shadcn 生态系统新增：react-bits 的 AeroShards、magicui 的 floating-3d-particles、reui 的 code-block 和 data-grid、intentui 的雷达图和径向条形图、blocks.so 的 AI 聊天线程、beui 的自适应步进器，以及 spectrumui 的七种定价区块变体。

keyQuotes: shadcn 发布了 cn，一个可无缝替换 clsx 和 tailwind-merge 的工具，速度提升 30 倍。
tooltip 和下拉菜单曾经意味着要写一堆 JavaScript 来让它们保持在屏幕内。
智能体将 UI 视为比迁移更低风险的工作，'智能体体验'正推动团队选择 React 而非 Solid 或 Lit。
你可以构建让智能体读取的网站，并在判断力仍有价值时，为 vibe-coded 的项目提供咨询服务。
